hypothesis: A dated predicted-cash-prefix constraint permits affordable investment before all lifetime care costs are paid, increasing real early production sales under unchanged net-terminal-value selection and execution. Existing observed assets alone may provide delayed conditional forecast credit.
scope: Finance feasibility and its necessary pure helpers/diagnostics only. Preserve R8 net_cash_model, net/labor execution scores, net selection, calendars, labor scheduling, action contracts, market and procurement rules. Prefix mode may reprice shared feed cash for funding without silently changing net ranking. full_reserve ablation must take the old R8 budget path.

credit_policy.assets: Freeze current own physically planted/placed assets from each observation. Opponent, seeds, unplaced animals, carried/shed goods and new permits receive no credit.
credit_policy.goods: Only non-WHEAT and non-FERTILIZER calendar production of qualified assets. Physical WHEAT inventory may offset cash feed demand once but no future WHEAT production or resale credit.
credit_policy.timing: Harvest-model day d credits no earlier than d+1. On every day deduct and test all costs first, then add that day credit. Current day credit is zero; day29 production has no permitted day30 credit.
credit_policy.valuation: Aggregate qualified same-product same-credit-day units once, multiplied by the single conditional post-batch price at modeled inventory on d+1, which already contains the d production. Do not add those units to inventory again. This is a conservative model endpoint quote, not claimed exact live execution.
credit_policy.new_project: New permits and unplaced commitments add dated costs/work and modeled supply only. They get no credit until a later real observation shows them in the field.
credit_policy.repricing: Trial views recheck the entire shared expense and credit prefix after additional supply. Each qualified credit batch is capped at min(original baseline batch credit, repriced batch credit). Rejecting a trial restores all shared state and cannot double-apply supply.
credit_policy.cash: Real current BUY/HIRE/material/land requests must fit actual observed cash and current commitments; neither same-frame unsold goods nor forecast credits increase actual market cash.
credit_policy.shortfall: Never clamp a negative prefix into solvency. Keep existing care. Preserve only old zero-new-cash owned-seed reuse when original q.cash_reserved_model==0 and every trial prefix is no lower than the existing baseline; mark EXISTING_SHORTFALL_ZERO_NEW_CASH_REUSE separately, never as fully financed.
credit_policy.costs: Only still-unpaid fixed commitments/new permits/land count principal at current date. Allocate real owned wheat once; cash feed only for required external units and old buffer. Keep opportunity cost in net ranking. Use dated Fibonacci wages/market-slot limits.
credit_policy.conditional_boundary: Ideal care, delivery, prices, and storage remain forecasts; next-day delay and origin restrictions do not guarantee real solvency or profitability.

promotion_rule.complete: All36 prescribed cells retained,719decisions per seat,zero errors,official/v3 full state parity,max callable<=1000ms. Preserve and stop on engine or candidate error. No outcome removal.
promotion_rule.strength: Against BOTH R0 and R8, for each opponent separately >=4/6 positive two-sided margin deltas, median>0, mean>=0 in each seat.
promotion_rule.primary: For EACH opponent separately, early self-produced non-WHEAT sales cash summed over6games must be >=1.2 times R8. Each seat3game sum must not decline. Use exact integer5*R9>=6*R8. Parent sum0 or any provenance PENDING does not automatically pass.
promotion_rule.boundary: Development prescreen only. FormalG1/G2/G3/G4/G5 still required; a local revenue increase does not qualify gold.

primary_mechanism.name: Real self-produced non-WHEAT gross sales cash during days0..9
primary_mechanism.unit: Actual accepted SELL at decision steps0..239 inclusive, including genuine fertilizer sales even though fertilizer receives no forecast credit.
primary_mechanism.provenance: Use frozen summarize_first_produced_sale_v3.py on frozen official saved-action audits. All qualifying non-WHEAT opening liquid stock and outside purchases must be zero; event flows nonnegative and exactly reconciled. Otherwise entire game is PENDING.
primary_mechanism.statistic: Raw realized early cash sums over fixed6game opponent block; compare candidate and parent totals, then independently3game seat sums. Zero early candidate sales is a legitimate0 when no event with complete evidence.

Current actual cash cannot borrow forecast income or same-frame SELL

Rejected trials do not change any shared supply, cost, credit or permit state
